findings.issue: The `view.street === 'preflop'` guard can never be false: StyleCheck only records steps whose `before.street === 'preflop'` (line 66), so the postflop branch is dead code.
findings.evidence: Line 66 `if (recordMixed && step.before.street === 'preflop')` filters steps; the gate coverage report lists style-check.ts line 113 as an uncovered branch.
findings.fix: Use `const chart = tagChartFor(view.players.length);`. The spec's §5 wording asked for the guard, so dropping it is a small, optional departure from the spec.

findings.issue: The postflop half of SPEC-03 compares decideTag with and without `chart: SIX_MAX_CHART`. recommend's postflop path never reads `chart`, so this comparison would pass even if decideTag passed the short-handed chart on postflop views. The explicit-chart half of the test does have teeth.
findings.evidence: recommend sends only preflop views to recommendPreflop, which is the only place `options.chart` is read (spec §3).
findings.fix: This is optional because the test is built exactly as the spec asks. A stronger check would spy on `recommend` (or check the options passed into it) and assert that no `chart` key is sent on postflop views. Otherwise, accept this half as a smoke check.

findings.issue: decideTag and StyleCheck each work out the short-handed chart with the same expression. If the selection rule changes later, one copy could be updated and the other missed.
findings.evidence: tag.ts `view.street === 'preflop' ? tagChartFor(view.players.length) : undefined`; style-check.ts:113 has the same expression.
findings.fix: This is optional. tagChartFor could take the PlayerView and check the street itself. The spec fixed the signature as `tagChartFor(dealtIn)`, so leaving it as is is fine.

summary: The implementation matches the spec. TAG_SHORT_HANDED_CHART swaps only the BTN and SB unopened cells for the CO unopened cells and keeps every other spot as the same object. tagChartFor returns the chart for 3 and 4 seats only. decideTag lets an explicit options.chart win and applies the chart only preflop. The style-check tally reads the same chart. The fast acceptance and unit tests would fail on a broken implementation: they derive the test classes from the chart, check advice against TAG's move at 3 and 4 seats against 5 and 6 seats, and the SPEC-05 tally is strict and is cross-checked against the 6-max tally. The slow test asserts every stat inside its healthy range and is opt-in. The approved locked edit to summary.acceptance.test.ts only removes the optional `returned` field from the fixture copy; both `largestPot` 140 assertions and the second test are unchanged. The fast tests pass locally (7/7) and gate fix-2 is PASS. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
